source: Federal Office of Topography swisstopo, official directory of localities with postcode and perimeter (Amtliches Ortschaftenverzeichnis mit Postleitzahl und Perimeter; ordinance on geographical names, art. 24)
terms: The free geodata and geoservices of swisstopo may be used, distributed and made accessible. Furthermore, they may be enriched and processed and also used commercially. A reference to the source is mandatory.
